observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F5.H2 removes the storage of precomputed job IDs on the parent builder and instead passes them to the exposure query builder. It also replaces the direct query construction with the instantiation of a new builder class, passing the exposure query and job IDs.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a mechanism where the exposure query is constructed with the necessary precomputed job IDs, potentially improving the separation of concerns and the reuse of the exposure query across different metric types.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F5.H3 adds a job_ids parameter to the exposure query builder and removes the MaturityGate parameter from the funnel, mean, and ratio query builders, replacing them with a call to the exposure query builder.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a mechanism where the exposure query is constructed and reused across different metric types, potentially improving the separation of concerns and the reuse of the exposure query.
